about_the_game:
About This Game – Motel Nightmares

Motel Nightmares is a first-person psychological horror experience that sends you deep into a supernatural mystery.

Unusual phenomena surrounding an abandoned roadside motel catch your attention. You set out to investigate the rumors firsthand — but what you find goes far beyond anything you imagined. The story begins with a car journey, but quickly descends into a disturbing, twisted reality.

Explore the motel and uncover its dark past. Solve ominous puzzles, discover hidden clues, and try to escape the forces that now surround you.

Will you uncover the truth — or become the motel’s next lost soul?

Features:

  • First-person psychological horror experience

  • Story begins with vehicle exploration and unfolds gradually

  • Paranormal investigation and atmosphere-driven gameplay

  • Environmental puzzles and immersive exploration

  • Minimal UI for total immersion

  • No combat — just fear, survival, and mystery

  • Headphones strongly recommended

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-9100 / AMD Ryzen 3 3200G
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 10

short_description: Trapped in an eerie, forgotten motel, you must uncover dark secrets and escape the nightmares that haunt every room. Motel Nightmares is a first-person psychological horror experience filled with mystery, tension, and atmospheric dread.
